t: These are the Temple Lodges at Abney Park, the gatehouses to Abney Park Cemetery. They are built mainly of stone and designed in an Egyptian Revival style, which was unusual for the time. The architect was William Hosking, who became the first Professor of Architecture at King's College London. Augustus Pugin was famously against the design, because it was not European, even though the public was fascinated by Egyptology then. So these gateways come with a bit of an argument attached.
